beats.say: $116 million: Godzilla Minus One smashed its way through the worldwide box office.
Takashi Yamazaki wrote, directed, and created the visual effects for this epic kaiju film.
Development of the movie began when Yamazaki devised the film plot in March 2019.
Filming took place across Chubu and Kanto from March to June 2022.
Toho International released the movie in North America on Tuesday 1 December.

facts: Takashi Yamazaki wrote, directed, and created the visual effects for Godzilla Minus One, a 2023 Japanese epic kaiju film.
Development of the movie began in March 2019 when Yamazaki devised the film plot.
Filming took place in Chubu and Kanto from March to June 2022.
Godzilla Minus One premiered at the Shinjuku Toho Building on October 18, 2023.
Toho International released the film in North America on December 1.
